Description:
High-capacity 24V 300Ah LiFePO4 Battery This 24V 300AH LiFePO4 battery pack delivers exceptional energy storage, ideal for off-grid systems, RVs, marine use, and solar setups with reliable long-term performance.

Advanced 200A BMS Protection System Equipped with a 200A BMS, this battery ensures intelligent protection against overcharge, over-discharge, short circuits, and overheating for enhanced safety and stability.

Ultra-Long Cycle Life Up to 8000+ Cycles With a lifespan of 8000+ charge cycles, this LiFePO4 battery offers unmatched durability, significantly outperforming traditional lead-acid batteries in longevity and reliability.

100% Max Depth of Discharge  Unlike conventional batteries, this unit supports 100% DOD, allowing full utilization of its 300AH nominal capacity without damaging the cells or reducing lifespan.
IP65 Waterproof & Rugged ABS Housing Built with IP65 waterproof rating and a durable ABS housing, this battery resists dust, moisture, and harsh environments, making it perfect for outdoor and marine applications.


24V 300AH LiFePO4 Battery Specifications:

Nominal Voltage: 25.6V
Nominal Capacity: 300Ah
Rated Capacity: 7680Wh
Battery Cell Composition: Lithium-Phosphat
Cycle Life: 4000 cycles at 100% DOD, 8000 cycles at 80% DOD, 15,000 cycles at 60% DOD
Months of Self Discharge: ≤3.5% per month at 25℃
Charge Voltage: 29.2±0.2V
Max. Charge Current: 100A/1C
Max. Continuous Current: 200A
Instantaneous discharge current: 400A 5second
Discharge Cut-off Voltage: 10.0V
Certificate: CE ROHS MSDS UN38.3 WEEE
Upgrade Parts/Accessories: Grade A
Voltage Protection Board(BMS): Yes
BMS:200A
Life Span:10 Years
Material: Lithium iron phosphate

Charge Temperature: 0 to 45℃ (32 to 113℉) at 60±25% relative humidity

Discharge Temperature: -30 to 60℃ (-4 to 140℉) at 60±25% relative humidity

Storage Temperature: 0 to 45℃ (32 to 113℉) at 60±25% relative humidity

Water Dust Resistance: IP65
Case Material: ABS
Dimension (L/W/H): 640*245*220mm
Weight: Approx. 40kg
Terminal Type: M8
Max. Expansion (Parallel & Series)：Up to 2 pcs batteries in Series,there is no limit in parallel.
